'''Hyperdrive''' was the Mattic family pet on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was taken by [[Elam Mattic]]'s brother to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when he decided to become a [[Miner/Legends|miner]].
